name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's motorsport journey began in the snowy backroads of Quebec, tinkering with snowmobiles before graduating to karting. A brief stint as a junior mechanic fueled his passion for the technical intricacies of racing, but he soon realized his organizational skills were better suited to managing the complex logistics of test programs. He joined Andretti Global five years ago and quickly became an indispensable part of the team, known for his meticulous planning and calm demeanor under pressure.

Jean-Pierre believes a well-coordinated test program is crucial for extracting maximum performance from the car. He meticulously analyzes data, anticipates potential issues, and works closely with both drivers and engineers to ensure every test session is productive. His ability to bridge the gap between the technical aspects of the car and the human element of driving makes him a highly valued asset. He is particularly skilled at optimizing testing plans to quickly isolate issues and improve performance.

What sets Jean-Pierre apart is his unwavering commitment to detail. He meticulously tracks every aspect of the testing process, from tire wear to fuel consumption, ensuring no stone is left unturned in the quest for improvement. His dedication to precision, combined with his technical understanding and management skills, makes him an exceptional test driver coordinator.

physical.description: Jean-Pierre is of average height and build with a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Insists on double-checking every calculation, even if it's already been verified by others.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
